title: The Ruined Canopy: The Verdant Oath
premise: Aster carries the First Seed through the last inhabited woodland. The Hollow Crown was once its protector; the silence of the bells bound it to an oath that no living voice can release.

factions.name: The Seedbearers
factions.belief: A living promise must be renewed, never enforced forever.

factions.name: The Bellwrights
factions.belief: Memory is a shared duty. Their silence allowed the Crown to keep an impossible oath.

factions.name: The Lastlight Keepers
factions.belief: Sanctuary means sheltering the stranger, even when the forest is afraid.

locations.history: The final refuge built beside the old root road. Its lamps are tended by Iri.
Soren keeps the broken bells and the testimonies of those who asked the Crown never to let them die.
The Seedbearers once read the sun here; a preserved ember teaches Seedflare.
Water drowned the gardens when their keeper tried to shelter every root from the same storm.
A working of the first oath survives in these living waterworks: Rootward.
The well preserves footsteps of a garden that no longer exists. Its memory teaches Bloomstep.

arc: Find the Verdant Disc and reconnect the root roads.
Meet the last inhabitants, learn the three living words, and recover two testimonies.
Return the First Seed to the Hollow Crown and release its impossible oath.
